WITH circuit_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    AVG(CAST(r.round AS FLOAT)) as circuit_avg_round
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(circuit_avg_round) as baseline
  FROM circuit_avg
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT 
  ca.circuitId,
  ca.country,
  ca.circuit_avg_round,
  ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.baseline as difference
FROM circuit_avg ca
JOIN country_baseline cb ON ca.country = cb.country
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.baseline IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.baseline DESC
LIMIT 10
